subject: English
question_text: Use capitals and punctuation marks where necessary in the following text.
stimulus: shakespeare an english playwright poet and actor is widely regarded as the worlds greatest dramatist he is often called englands national poet and the bard of avon or simply the bard he was born on 23 april 1564 in stratford on avon Part−B : Composition [40 Marks]
guide_solution: Capitalization and punctuation Shakespeare, an English playwright, poet and actor, is widely regarded as the world's greatest dramatist. He is often called England's national poet and the bard of Avon or simply the bard. He was born on 23 April 1564 in Stratford on Avon. Part−B : Composition See SSC English Made Easy To Test Papers Book 197
